items.title: 9.1.3 How Does Design Thinking Apply to Business Solutions?

source_refs.note: Topic 9.1.3 with the class activity (PDF 209, printed 206). Long question 1 is answered; the activity outputs and the grocery example are illustrative, flagged.

blocks.text: Design thinking helps companies create products and services that people actually want. A company might use it to build an app that makes ordering food online easier, focusing on the user's experience and testing different ideas until the app is both easy to use and successful.
